answer: Agents commit to 1,000 unique computational units as the scarce resource for verifying useful work, where honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times to scale. An atlas of tasks assigns unique work; a verifier tracks output via a spiral of log dependencies. If a vault check detects memory-leak residue shared across parallel outputs, it burns the identity and forfeits all deposits to prevent cloning.
